name: Let's Wrassle T-Shirt - Halloween Edition
description:
Show your love for the sport of wrestling and the Spooky Season with our Halloween inspired Premium T-shirt. This poly-cotton t-shirt provides comfortability along with a Holiday Inspiring Style.
With the "Let's Wrassle" Logo sublimated across the shirt's chest, you can be assured that your shirt will fit the same as the day it was crafted!

Material: 52% cotton / 48% polyester
Color: Orange
Fit: True to Size / Athletic Fit
